text: Implemented axis-bound Column[S,A] plus direct Resample4s bindings. Selection, Injection, Permutation, and Draw remain concrete types; draw repetition uses unique DrawOccurrence keys retaining source identity/multiplicity; each binding supplies a sparse typed Multivar Lin restriction. Column construction/decode rejects length, duplicate-axis-key, runtime owner, and nominal witness mismatches; wrong-axis use has a compile-time regression. Full mvpa suites pass JVM 138/138 and JS 138/138; zero-cruft --freeze and git diff --check pass.
